fee_notes: The standard initial franchise fee for the 1st Franchise Agreement is $49,500 (covering 1 Territory of ~200,000 population). For simultaneous multi-unit signings, the fee per agreement decreases: 2nd agreement $40,000, 3rd $35,000, 4th–10th $30,000 each. An Additional Population Fee of $0.25 per person over 200,000 may apply. A 10% veterans' discount applies to the first franchise for honorably discharged veterans (and their spouses) who own at least 51% of the Business. During the 2025 fiscal year, franchisees actually paid total initial fees ranging from $5,000 to $44,750.
raw_excerpt:
When you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay us a lump sum initial franchise fee as set forth in the table below. We impose the initial franchise fee uniformly. The initial franchise fee is not refundable under any circumstances.

1st: $49,500 | 2nd: $40,000 | 3rd: $35,000 | 4th: $30,000 | 5th: $30,000 | 6th: $30,000 | 7th: $30,000 | 8th: $30,000 | 9th: $30,000 | 10th: $30,000

During our 2025 fiscal year, Heavyweight Waste franchisees signing our franchise agreement paid total initial fees to us and/or our affiliates ranging from $5,000 to $44,750.
